summary.headline: GPT-5.5 lands as Meta cuts 8,000 jobs for AI
summary.body: A heavy news day. OpenAI released GPT-5.5, an agent-focused model that it rates High risk for biological and cyber capability. That raises both Capability Velocity and AI Autonomy, lifting endings that need powerful, independent AI: Descendants, Zookeeper, Protector God and Conquerors. Meta confirmed about 8,000 layoffs, roughly 10%, starting May 20 to fund its AI build-out. That cuts into Shared Prosperity and pulls Egalitarian Utopia down. Tennessee's new law declaring that AI cannot be a legal person draws a firmer line between humans and machines, weakening Human–AI Merging and trimming Descendants. Tencent's open Hy3 model was a small counterweight to power concentration. Horizon Balance slipped to +1.77, down 0.17, and two endings swapped places.
summary.movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia -0.5 came from Meta's layoffs (-0.56). Zookeeper +0.5, Protector God +0.5 and Conquerors +0.5 were driven by the GPT-5.5 release (+0.56, +0.52 and +0.52).

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5, rated 'High' for bio and cyber risk
events.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.5, an agent-oriented frontier model claiming state of the art on 14 benchmarks, rated High under its Preparedness Framework for biological and cybersecurity capability.
events.reason: New frontier model with notable gains in agentic coding; benchmarks self-reported.

events.title: Meta confirms ~8,000 layoffs (10%) to offset massive AI spending
events.summary: An internal memo confirmed Meta will cut about 8,000 jobs and close 6,000 open roles from May 20 to run more efficiently while pouring money into AI infrastructure.
events.reason: Mass layoff at a frontier AI company tied to redirecting capital to AI.

events.title: Tennessee law excludes AI from legal definition of 'person'
events.summary: Tennessee SB 837 took effect, amending state code so AI systems, algorithms and machines cannot be legal persons, hold rights or bear liability independently. Exact signing date unclear; effective date used.
events.reason: Rubric T2 down example: law explicitly bans AI personhood (state level).

events.title: Tencent previews open-source Hy3 mixture-of-experts model
events.summary: Tencent released Hy3 preview, an open 295B-parameter MoE model claiming large efficiency gains.
events.reason: Mid-size open-weights release from a Chinese giant. Date approximate (week of Apr 20-24).
